problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}-7 & -6 & 2 \\ -2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

By applying elementary column operations of the form ${C}_{i}:={C}_{i}+k{C}_{3},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary column operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make entries to the left of ${a}_{33}=1$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary column operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 2 \\ 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-3{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-7 & 2 & 2 \\ -2 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-4{C}_{3}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-7 & -6 & 2 \\ -2 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the elementary column operations are

$\,$ ${C}_{1}:={C}_{1}-3{C}_{3}\,$ and $\,{C}_{2}:={C}_{2}-4{C}_{3}.$
